My publications cover spatial causal inference, spatiotemporal statistics, statistical distribution theory, and applied statistical modelling, with applications in environmental science, public health, and related fields.

For an updated publication and citation record, visit my [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=b1FDqykAAAAJ&hl=en) or [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2272-1530) profile.
